run_unsup_select_cli: run the unsupervised metric selection tool with reference and hypothesis transcript files
compute_wer_function: compute word error rate between reference and hypothesis transcripts using edit distance
compute_lm_ppl_function: compute language model perplexity for hypothesis transcripts using a kenlm scoring function
load_tra_function: load a transcript file into a uid-to-transcript dictionary mapping utterance IDs to text
load_lex_function: load a phoneme lexicon file into a word-to-phonemes dictionary mapping
